name: mockinterview
description: Practice software-engineering interviews inside Claude Code: timed live-coding and system-design rounds run by an Interviewer persona, a Teacher for explanations, your own problems as Markdown packs, and scorecards with history.

default_level.title: Default level
default_level.description: Level used by /mockinterview:interview. Choose ask to be asked every time.

default_language.title: Default solution language
default_language.description: Language id for live-coding solutions, used when you do not name one. Built in: python, javascript, go, rust. Your own language files are listed by mi.py langs.

packs_dir.title: Extra packs folder
packs_dir.description: Optional folder with your own problem and knowledge packs (Markdown files). Leave empty to use only the built-in content and the optional ~/.mockinterview/packs and .mockinterview/packs folders.

pane_auto_open.title: Open the pane automatically
pane_auto_open.description: Mod only: open the interview pane when a session starts. Needs a terminal wide enough for the pane.

strict_guard.title: Block reading hidden pack files during an interview
strict_guard.description: Mod only: refuse reads of pack files while an interview round is active. This prevents accidental spoilers; it is not a security feature.
